name: Cannoli Pie
desc: A no-bake cannoli cream of cream cheese and ricotta in a baked crust, under chocolate ganache and whipped cream.

source.title: Best Cannoli Pie
source.evidence: Identical filling, ganache and whipped cream amounts (two 8 oz cream cheese, 1 cup ricotta, 1 1/2 cups cream, orange zest, cinnamon, mini chips) and the same 50% power ganache method.

ingredients.raw: 1 refrigerated pie crust (from a 14.1 oz box of 2), for a 9-inch pie plate
ingredients.note: from a 14.1 oz box of 2; for a 9-inch pie plate

ingredients.raw: 2 (8 oz) packages full-fat cream cheese, slightly softened
2 tsp vanilla extract or vanilla bean paste
ingredients.item: vanilla extract or vanilla bean paste

ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 cups mini semisweet chocolate chips

steps: Fit the crust into a 9-inch pie plate and crimp the edge. Blind bake according to the package directions, lined with parchment and pie weights, until light golden brown. Cool completely, about 30 minutes.
Filling: beat the cream cheese, ricotta, heavy cream, powdered sugar, vanilla, orange zest and cinnamon with a mixer until smooth, light and fluffy, 4-5 minutes. Fold in the mini chocolate chips.
Spread the filling in the cooled crust and refrigerate at least 2 hours (or freeze 45 minutes), until firm on top.

Ganache: microwave the chocolate chips and 3 tbsp cream at 50% power for 45 seconds, stir, then continue in 15-second bursts, stirring each time, until smooth. Pour over the chilled filling, spread to the edges, and refrigerate 1-2 hours until set.
Whipped cream: beat the cold cream to soft peaks, add the powdered sugar, and beat to stiff peaks.
Pipe or spread the whipped cream over the pie. Top with mini chocolate chips, the cannoli and pistachios. Keep refrigerated.
tips: Full-fat cream cheese, whole-milk ricotta and heavy cream give the firmest set; low-fat versions stay loose.

references.title: Best Cannoli Pie
references.usedFor: confirmed filling, ganache and topping amounts, 4 to 5 minute beat, 2 hour chill or 45 minute freeze, yield
